sources.snippet: ABR's asr-38m-v1-en SSM The asr-38m-v1-en model is a State Space Model (SSM) with attention that performs automatic speech recognition (ASR), trained and released by Applied Brain Research (ABR). This model contains ~38m parameters, transcribes speech in English, and was trained on 15k hours of speech data (competitors use about 200k hours).
